main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-day move after a forecast rise of >= 2 points

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of the same day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper minus lower half (forecast median split) mean unusual move

decided_by: Neither the confirm nor the reject rule holds (a t between -2 and 2 on the main measure or the supporting check).
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 from its lowest level since the last bet, from 0 after flat) in each 3-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, drift is the coin's mean grid 3-bar return over all its windows, the upper half is forecast > median and the lower half forecast <= median, the day-clustered t uses a D/(D-1) correction, and the plan's 'too few cases is inconclusive' is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.501 (not below 1), 233 cases (30 needed)
